overview: The camera packet is clientbound and server-authoritative, so anticheats see it only on send. Exactly two consumers act on it: Grim's CompensatedCameraEntity records which entity the server ordered the client to spectate, and intave's AbilityTracker marks the player as having a view entity so its movement checks treat spectator camera motion as legitimate. The rest of the corpus is keyword noise: Photon's CanSee family and TruthfulAC's AimB mention cameras in the ESP raycast and aim domains without touching the packet, and Artemis and Negativity only register the packet type.

checks.name: CompensatedCameraEntity (Grim)
checks.purpose: Track the spectated entity id from the camera packet so entity checks keep measuring against the right body.
checks.how_it_works: A PreVia packet send listener on the CAMERA packet. It reads the camera entity id from the S43 packet, sends a transaction, and on the next real-time task resolves the id against the compensated entity map, keeping a single-entry queue of possible camera targets. isSelf() reports whether the view is back on the player's own body and getPossibilities() exposes the candidates to other checks.
checks.detects: Nothing directly. It is state sync: the spectated entity becomes the reference body for entity-dependent checks while the player's view is attached elsewhere.
checks.variations: intave AbilityTracker.receiveCamera is the only other consumer, and it stores a view-entity boolean instead of the entity itself.

checks.name: AbilityTracker.receiveCamera (intave)
checks.purpose: Record when the server moves the player's view onto another entity, so movement checks exempt spectator camera motion.
checks.how_it_works: A CAMERA packet subscription on the abilities tracker module. receiveCamera reads the entity id from the packet and schedules a tick-synchronized update that sets hasViewEntity to true when the id differs from the player's own entity id. AbilityMetadata.isSpectatorLike() (line 311) returns true for a player whose game mode is spectator or whose hasViewEntity is set, which movement checks use to skip flags that would otherwise fire for spectator motion.
checks.detects: Nothing directly. It prevents false positives: the view-entity flag keeps spectator camera movement out of the normal movement checks.
checks.variations: Grim CompensatedCameraEntity keeps the spectated entity itself and reports whether the view is on the player, instead of a boolean flag.
